title: Pancyclicity in Graph Families with the Ore-Type Condition
summary: Let $ n \in \mathbb{N} $ with $ n \geq 3 $, and let $\mathcal{G} = \{G_i:i\in [n]\} $ be a family of $ n $-vertex graphs on a common vertex set $V$, where the graphs in the family do not need to be distinct. A graph $H$ with vertex set $V$ is \emph{rainbow} in $\mathcal{G}$ if there exists an injection $ φ: E(H) \to [n] $ such that $e \in E(G_{φ(e)})$ for every edge $e \in E(H)$, where $|E(H)|\leq n$.
